name: Plasma-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The largest bright mass fills the upper frame with clearly readable lobes and shadows.

tagline: Soft white blobs swell and fold out of black like smoke.
summary: A raymarched mass of white and grey folds against black, like dense smoke or melting wax. The form kneads and re-forms continuously, and dragging the pointer nudges its shape.
appearance: Smooth, rounded volumes of white and mid-grey emerging from a black field, with soft shading that hints at depth. Edges are blurry and slightly stepped, and the composition sits mostly in the upper half.
behaviour: The mass bulges and contracts at a slow, even rate, with brighter highlights swelling and fading. Pointer movement shifts the field so the shape responds to the cursor, then eases back.
use_when: A dark abstract hero needs slow, heavy organic movement with no content of its own.
avoid_when: You want colour: unless a tint is passed the surface renders white and grey.
customise: Tint colour, speed, direction (including ping-pong), scale, opacity and pointer interaction are props. The raymarch shape itself is fixed.
weight_why: A per-pixel raymarch loop of sixty steps runs every animation frame.

a11y.note: Decorative and always morphing, with no reduced-motion check despite the constant movement.

issues: The default colour makes the plasma render white and grey, not the colourful swirl the description suggests.
Blob edges show stair-stepping and stay soft out of focus.
polish_why: A pleasant organic mass, but it is mushy, aliased and colourless as recorded.
title: Plasma
